本章贯穿案例

手写前向与反传：对照 autograd 和有限差分

同一个 17 参数、2→3→2 的网络贯穿三条输入、半均方误差、五组导数与一次 SGD；手算、autograd、有限差分及更新后的参数形成四种互相对应的证据。

运行时应核对

五组手写梯度与 autograd 一致；第一层梯度与中心有限差分一致；nn.Linear 前向一致，共 17 个参数。 固定学习率 0.1 时半均方误差从约 0.092791667 变为 0.082768803；四组参数与手工更新一致，输入保持不变。

mlp_manual-backprop.py
import torchfrom torch import nn torch.manual_seed(7)torch.set_num_threads(1)dtype = torch.float64# 每一行是一条样本；参数形状与 nn.Linear 完全相同。x = torch.tensor([[1., -2.], [.5, 1.], [-1., .25]], dtype=dtype)y = torch.tensor([[.5, -.1], [.7, .4], [-.2, .8]], dtype=dtype)w1 = torch.tensor([[.7, -.3], [-.4, .8], [.5, .2]], dtype=dtype)b1 = torch.tensor([.2, .1, .4], dtype=dtype)w2 = torch.tensor([[.6, -.2, .4], [-.3, .5, .7]], dtype=dtype)b2 = torch.tensor([.1, -.2], dtype=dtype) # 前向：B×2 -> B×3 -> B×2；平方误差对所有输出元素平均。def forward(x, w1, b1, w2, b2):    z = x @ w1.T + b1    h = z.clamp_min(0)    prediction = h @ w2.T + b2    return prediction, z, h prediction, z, h = forward(x, w1, b1, w2, b2)error = prediction - yloss = error.square().mean() / 2assert z.abs().min() > 1e-3  # 有限差分不跨过 ReLU 的折点。 # 手写向量—Jacobian 乘积，不构造庞大的完整 Jacobian。dprediction = error / error.numel()dw2 = dprediction.T @ hdb2 = dprediction.sum(0)dh = dprediction @ w2dz = dh * (z > 0).to(dtype)dw1 = dz.T @ xdb1 = dz.sum(0)dx = dz @ w1manual = [dx, dw1, db1, dw2, db2]assert torch.equal(dz[z < 0], torch.zeros_like(dz[z < 0])) # 独立让 autograd 求导；不要在手写结果上再调用 backward。variables = [v.clone().requires_grad_() for v in (x, w1, b1, w2, b2)]xa, wa1, ba1, wa2, ba2 = variablesreference, _, _ = forward(xa, wa1, ba1, wa2, ba2)reference_loss = (reference - y).square().mean() / 2automatic = torch.autograd.grad(reference_loss, variables)for name, actual, expected in zip(("x", "w1", "b1", "w2", "b2"), manual, automatic):    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-10)    print(name, tuple(actual.shape), "gradient agrees") # 第三个证据：对第一层每个权重进行中心有限差分。epsilon = 1e-6finite = torch.zeros_like(w1)for row in range(w1.shape[0]):    for column in range(w1.shape[1]):        plus, minus = w1.clone(), w1.clone()        plus[row, column] += epsilon        minus[row, column] -= epsilon        p_plus = forward(x, plus, b1, w2, b2)[0]        p_minus = forward(x, minus, b1, w2, b2)[0]        l_plus = (p_plus - y).square().mean() / 2        l_minus = (p_minus - y).square().mean() / 2        finite[row, column] = (l_plus - l_minus) / (2 * epsilon)torch.testing.assert_close(dw1, finite, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-8) # 将同一组参数装进 nn.Module，验证权重朝向和偏置广播。model = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2, 3), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(3, 2)).to(dtype)with torch.no_grad():    model[0].weight.copy_(w1)    model[0].bias.copy_(b1)    model[2].weight.copy_(w2)    model[2].bias.copy_(b2)torch.testing.assert_close(model(x), prediction)assert sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()) == 17print("loss =", round(loss.item(), 6))print("通过：前向、五组梯度、有限差分和 17 个参数。") # 使用刚刚计算的旧参数梯度，同时更新四组参数；输入不由 optimizer 管理。learning_rate = 0.1expected_parameters = [parameter - learning_rate * gradient                       for parameter, gradient in zip((w1, b1, w2, b2), (dw1, db1, dw2, db2))]input_before = x.clone()optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=learning_rate)optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)module_loss = (model(x) - y).square().mean() / 2module_loss.backward()optimizer.step()for actual, expected in zip(model.parameters(), expected_parameters):    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12)torch.testing.assert_close(x, input_before, rtol=0, atol=0)with torch.no_grad():    updated_prediction = model(x)    updated_loss = (updated_prediction - y).square().mean() / 2assert abs(updated_loss.item() - 0.08276880316466285) < 1e-12assert updated_loss < lossprint("one SGD step:", loss.item(), "->", updated_loss.item())print("first updated prediction:", updated_prediction[0].tolist())print("输入保持不变；四组参数的手写更新与 SGD 一致。")

补充演示的观察目标

输出参数量 354；200 步后同一合成训练集的 MSE 低于初始值，两个探针的输出形状为 [2,2]。数值尾数可随环境略变。

python 09_mlp_demo.py环境配置

补充演示：训练一个二维非线性函数近似器

09_mlp_demo.py
import torchfrom torch import nn torch.manual_seed(7)# STEP 1: 构造两个通用的非线性合成函数features = torch.randn(128, 8)target = torch.stack([    features[:, 0] + 0.2 * features[:, 1].square(),    features[:, 2].sin() + 0.1 * features[:, 3] * features[:, 4],], dim=-1)model = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(8, 32), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(32, 2))parameter_count = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())assert parameter_count == (8 * 32 + 32) + (32 * 2 + 2) == 354print("parameters:", parameter_count) # STEP 2: 固定训练数据，检查前向、求导和更新是否工作optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.03, weight_decay=0.)initial_loss = (model(features) - target).square().mean().item()for step in range(200):    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)    prediction = model(features)    loss = (prediction - target).square().mean()    loss.backward()    optimizer.step() # STEP 3: 同一训练集的拟合检查，不作为样本外泛化结果model.eval()with torch.no_grad():    final_loss = (model(features) - target).square().mean().item()    sample = model(features[:2])assert sample.shape == (2, 2) and torch.isfinite(sample).all()assert final_loss < initial_lossprint("training MSE:", round(initial_loss, 5), "->", round(final_loss, 5))print("two function outputs:", sample)

完整合成序列回归：有效池化、标准化、更新和恢复

构造只依赖有效 token 均值的合成回归任务，以 CPU 训练小 MLP；训练统计随 state_dict 一起保存，留出误差与训练误差分别报告。

运行时应核对

固定合成训练损失显著降低，所有梯度有限；Padding 改成 NaN 不改变池化；恢复后预测一致。留出损失只描述这个合成任务。

mlp_readout-training.py
import torchfrom torch import nn torch.manual_seed(17)torch.set_num_threads(1) # 合成任务刻意只依赖有效 token 的均值，不能据此推断空间定位能力。count, time, features = 192, 5, 4raw = torch.randn(count, time, features) * torch.tensor([1., 10., .1, 3.])lengths = torch.randint(1, time + 1, (count,))valid = torch.arange(time)[None, :] < lengths[:, None]raw = raw.masked_fill(~valid[..., None], 1000.) def masked_mean(tokens, mask):    if mask.dtype != torch.bool or mask.shape != tokens.shape[:2]:        raise ValueError("mask 必须是与 B,T 对齐的 bool 张量")    denominator = mask.sum(1, keepdim=True)    if (denominator == 0).any():        raise ValueError("每条样本至少需要一个有效 token")    clean = tokens.masked_fill(~mask[..., None], 0)    return clean.sum(1) / denominator pooled = masked_mean(raw, valid)base = pooled / torch.tensor([1., 10., .1, 3.])target = torch.stack((.7 * base[:, 0].sin() + .3 * base[:, 1] * base[:, 2],                      .5 * base[:, 2] - .4 * base[:, 3].square()), dim=-1)train_x, test_x = pooled[:144], pooled[144:]train_y, test_y = target[:144], target[144:]# 只使用训练集统计；标准化目标也就明确了各输出维度的损失权重。x_mean = train_x.mean(0)x_std = train_x.std(0, correction=0).clamp_min(1e-6)y_mean = train_y.mean(0)y_std = train_y.std(0, correction=0).clamp_min(1e-6) class Readout(nn.Module):    def __init__(self):        super().__init__()        self.register_buffer("x_mean", x_mean.clone())        self.register_buffer("x_std", x_std.clone())        self.register_buffer("y_mean", y_mean.clone())        self.register_buffer("y_std", y_std.clone())        self.network = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(features, 32), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(32, 2))        for layer in self.network:            if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear):                nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight)                nn.init.zeros_(layer.bias)     def forward(self, x):        return self.network((x - self.x_mean) / self.x_std)     def predict(self, x):        return self(x) * self.y_std + self.y_mean model = Readout()optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=.02, weight_decay=1e-4)normalized_target = (train_y - model.y_mean) / model.y_stdwith torch.no_grad():    initial = (model(train_x) - normalized_target).square().mean().item()first_weight = model.network[0].weight.detach().clone()model.train()for step in range(240):    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)    prediction = model(train_x)    loss = (prediction - normalized_target).square().mean()    loss.backward()    assert all(p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() for p in model.parameters())    if step == 0:        print("initial gradient norm =", model.network[0].weight.grad.norm().item())    optimizer.step() model.eval()with torch.no_grad():    final = (model(train_x) - normalized_target).square().mean().item()    holdout_mse = (model.predict(test_x) - test_y).square().mean().item()assert final < initial * .15  # 只检查这个固定合成任务的优化链路。assert not torch.equal(first_weight, model.network[0].weight)assert torch.isfinite(torch.tensor(holdout_mse))# 将无效内容改成 NaN，仍应得到同一有效均值。poisoned = raw.masked_fill(~valid[..., None], float("nan"))torch.testing.assert_close(masked_mean(poisoned, valid), pooled)# state_dict 同时包含网络参数和预处理统计。restored = Readout()restored.load_state_dict(model.state_dict())with torch.no_grad():    torch.testing.assert_close(restored.predict(test_x), model.predict(test_x))print(f"train normalized MSE: {initial:.6f} -> {final:.6f}")print(f"holdout MSE in original units: {holdout_mse:.6f}")print("通过：有效池化、训练更新、有限验证损失与含统计量的恢复。")

构造 ReLU 插值网络并核对误差阶与导数

不用优化器，直接把分段线性插值写成 1→K→11\to K\to11→K→1 网络，分别核对节点、最大误差和分段斜率。

运行时应核对

宽度 4、8、16 时，x2x^2x2 的最大插值误差分别是 0.015625、0.00390625、0.0009765625；全部节点值和区间斜率一致。没有执行训练，结果不能解释为优化收敛率。

mlp_constructive-spline.py
import torchfrom torch import nn torch.set_num_threads(1)dtype = torch.float64 def interpolation_mlp(knots, values):    """仅在 [knots[0], knots[-1]] 上使用；固定参数实现线性插值。"""    if knots.ndim != 1 or values.shape != knots.shape or knots.numel() < 2:        raise ValueError("需要至少两个一维节点和同形函数值")    if not torch.all(knots[1:] > knots[:-1]):        raise ValueError("节点必须严格递增")    slopes = (values[1:] - values[:-1]) / (knots[1:] - knots[:-1])    changes = torch.cat((slopes[:1], slopes[1:] - slopes[:-1]))    net = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(1, len(slopes)), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(len(slopes), 1)).to(dtype)    with torch.no_grad():        net[0].weight.fill_(1.)        net[0].bias.copy_(-knots[:-1])        net[2].weight.copy_(changes[None, :])        net[2].bias.copy_(values[:1])    return net for intervals in (4, 8, 16):    knots = torch.linspace(0., 1., intervals + 1, dtype=dtype)    net = interpolation_mlp(knots, knots.square())    torch.testing.assert_close(net(knots[:, None]).squeeze(-1), knots.square())    midpoints = (knots[:-1] + knots[1:]) / 2    error = net(midpoints[:, None]).squeeze(-1) - midpoints.square()    # 对 x²，每一段中点误差恰好是 h²/4，并非从训练曲线拟合的经验率。    torch.testing.assert_close(error, torch.full_like(error, 1 / (4 * intervals ** 2)))    probe = (knots[:-1] + (knots[1:] - knots[:-1]) / 3).requires_grad_()    slope = torch.autograd.grad(net(probe[:, None]).sum(), probe)[0]    expected_slope = (knots[1:].square() - knots[:-1].square()) / (knots[1:] - knots[:-1])    torch.testing.assert_close(slope, expected_slope)    print(f"width={intervals}, max_error={error.max().item():.8f}, verified slopes") print("这是构造性表示实验，没有执行优化；它不保证训练能找到这组参数，也不刻画区间外误差。")
